title: Mahou Kishi Rayearth
description: Magic Knight Rayearth is a 1995 Japanese video game developed and published by Sega for the Sega Saturn in 1995. It is an action role-playing video game based on the animeseries of the same title (Magic Knight Rayearth). The game was later released in North America by Working Designs in 1998, making it the last Saturn game released in North America in 1998. The game focuses on three characters who travel the world of Cephiro to rescue an abducted princess named Emerald.
